name: Carbonov Design
headline: Car Customization Services - Carbonov Design
lede: Enjoy the experience of customizing your luxury or sports car with Carbonov Design, car wrapping & modification services.
about: Commercial art wrap was done in USA, Los Angeles in 2015 in collaboration with Stickercity LA for Titan Natural Focus energy drink brand. Concept artwork was beautifully adopted from the brand style, mixed with styling car body shapes design touches and fulfilled by Gold Chrome brought a lot of "noise" in Los Angeles streets.

One of the first project for 2020 Ferrari 488 Challenge Evo racing cars, for today we made 7 different concepts around the world. Elegant and aggressive design, highlight the shapes of the car and same time brings more sharpness to curvy shapes of the car. First time we used technology of Gloss/Matt "Stealth" combination for 100% racing cars gave us touch of extra elegance, unusual for racing livery standards.
